description: This file contains automated tests for new C# language features using the Xunit testing framework within the PDFsharp project. It specifically tests features like range operators and collection expressions, and references several PDFsharp components and testing helpers.

classes.name: CSharpFeaturesTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies usage of upcoming C# language features within the PDFsharp test suite.

methods.name: Range_and_Index
methods.description: Tests the usage of range and index operators introduced in C# 8.

methods.name: Collection_expressions
methods.description: Tests collection expressions syntax proposed for C# 12, such as array and list initialization using literals.
